verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents call analytics dashboards showing success rates, durations, outcomes or sentiment. The Dashboard is cited only for the voice library, the HIPAA toggle and test calls. Evals and Voice Test Suites are pre-production testing tools, not analytics on live calls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see call analytics — success rates, durations, outcomes, sentiment — in dashboards without building my own
